title: Some good things, some bad things
text:
Some good things, some bad things. Using this vacuum is joyless. It looks and feels very commercial and utilitarian. (Translation: ugly, heavy and durable) As a result, it completely lacks any finesse and any modern qualities.
•The color is horrific and screams hotel lobby
•It is a bagged vaccum
•No attachments/hoses
•Cord hook doesn't turn upside down to release cord. So you have to unwind 50 feet if cord manually
•Very heavy
I love having a beater bar and a carpet pile adjustment. I love having a metal plate to quickly access bottom of vacuum/ water bar. I love turning on with my foot with button on top of the base of unit. It seems to get majority of cat hair off carpet. Am I thrilled? No. Will it work? Yes, til I replace it with something more this century

product_metadata.title: Sanitaire Tradition Upright Bagged Commercial Vacuum, SC886G 8.5" x 17.3" x 21.3
features: Extended Life Motor provides more than 2,000 hours of commercial-grade cleaning performance, which is 5 times the motor life of the average household vacuum.
Durable structure includes a chrome hood that’s safe for tough environments and a looped handle for comfort.

Unique maintenance features, like the tool-free brush roll and belt replacement, Quick KleenTM Fan Chamber, and metal clip bag release system, make this commercial vacuum easy-to-use and easy-to-maintain.
Large-capacity shake out bag holds up to 18 quarts of dirt and debris for less interruption while cleaning. Sound Level - 79 dBA
Commercial-grade detachable power cord is durable and has a 50-foot reach to reduce the need to switch plugs as often, and provides a potential cleaning area of 7,800 sq. ft.
description: The Sanitaire TRADITION Upright Commercial Vacuum utilizes heavy-duty features to give you longevity of use and a more productive machine at a low cost of ownership. The chrome hood protects the machine in tough environments, while its Extended Life Motor gives more than 2,000 hours of commercial cleaning power. The large shake out bag holds up to 18 quarts of dirt and debris before it needs to be emptied. The TRADITION Upright Commercial Vacuum is also easy to maintain with special features like its Chrome Brush Roll with replaceable bristle strips and the Quick Kleen Fan Chamber that helps you see and clear clogs as they happen.
